agentdb-watch._comment: Daily check: has AgentDB integration shipped?

backup-memory._comment: Daily rotating backup of ruflo memory.db (before sync-state push)

cc-changelog-review._comment: Weekly CC changelog diff — writes ~/.claude/cc-changelog-report.md if changes found (t-512)

close-extraction._comment: ADR-052 Track 2: nightly extraction — agy pass per queued close snapshot, learnings to reminders, daily summary.

export-patterns._comment: ADR-015: weekly JSON export of all ruflo namespaces to git

feed-poll._comment: t-1009: poll all registered RSS/Atom feeds 3x daily

feed-ruflo-index._comment: t-1138: store new feed entries to ruflo memory_entries for semantic search. Timeout 3600: indexing runs ~2 sections/s; backfill bulges (2026-06-12: 1783 sections ≈ 20min) blow a 300s cap

feed-summarize._comment: t-1139: fetch anthropic-news article URLs, summarize via claude -p → feed-summaries.jsonl (feed-index joins at 19:00). Timeout 3600: backfill bulges (2026-06-12: 230 entries × ~15s) blow a 300s cap

knowledge-pipeline-tier1._comment: t-1136: nightly Tier 1+2 LinkedIn URL relevance filter + cluster assignment. Enabled 2026-04-12 after dry-run passed clean. Tier 3 is manual only.
knowledge-pipeline-tier1.command: brana knowledge process --tier1 && brana knowledge process --tier2

link-research-extraction._comment: t-2306: capped pass over pending link-tagged tasks from telegram link-capture. t-2560 (2026-07-31): repointed from ./deploy/research-extraction.sh to the Rust subcommand, which completes a task ONLY after its content reaches the knowledge base — the gate the old script lacked (it marked completed on `claude -p` exit 0 while persisting nothing; personal-repo t-1366, P0, 6 links burned). STILL DISABLED pending a human enable: see t-2560. t-1364 (2026-08-01): wrapped in drain-links.sh — pull before drain, commit+push results after; preserves drain rc.

lint-heal._comment: t-1075: weekly L2 memory lint+heal — dedup, contradiction detection, frontmatter imputation. Runs after knowledge-decay (13:00).

memory-consolidation._comment: t-1834: threshold-triggered L3 consolidation — debrief-flag consumption + frontmatter date normalization. OR trigger: >24h OR >=5 sessions. Does NOT call lint-heal.sh (no lock collision). Runs Mon-Sat only (Sun handled by lint-heal at 15:00 which resets session counter).

personal-repo-pull._comment: t-2306: laptop sees new tasks/event-log entries from oracle-hub's link-capture cron without manual git pull

reindex-knowledge._comment: Weekly full reindex — runs at noon Sun (moved from 2am: cold-boot MCP unavailable, t-1101)

reindex-patterns._comment: Weekly pattern namespace reindex — runs at 3am (after knowledge reindex), ~1h max (t-857)

second-phase-review._comment: ADR-021: weekly check for time-gated second-phase tasks

staleness-report._comment: Weekly staleness check on spec docs

statusline-slow-cache._comment: t-1023: write ruflo health, portfolio pulse, knowledge freshness to statusline slow-cache every 5min

sync-state._comment: ADR-015: daily safety net — sync operational state from cache to repos

oracle-brana-drift._comment: t-2501: audits oracle-hub brana manifest (ship-brana-oracle.sh provenance) — UNMANAGED/SWAPPED/DRIFT exit 1 -> FAILED job = the visible signal. Unreachable hub is a clean skip (exit 0). noProjectLock: read-only wrt shared state (ssh + own git fetch); also avoids the 600s lock-wait vs 180s TimeoutStartSec kill window (seen 2026-08-02 smoke run).

knowledge-vector-sync._comment: t-2620: sync the brana-owned vector store (~/.claude/memory/knowledge.db) from ruflo memory_entries. Runs 20min after each drain-links pass so freshly drained links become topic-searchable. Idempotent (newest row per key wins); unreadable sources are skipped loudly.

link-research-extraction-youtube._comment: t-2956 (feature spec §5, docs/architecture/features/youtube-knowledge-extraction.md): youtube is excluded from link-research-extraction's shared batch and drains here instead, its own --platform filter, own cap, own backoff/retry (yt-dlp's HTTP 429 handling lives inside fetch_youtube_content, not this job) — so a stuck or retrying youtube fetch can only starve this job's own slots, never LinkedIn/GitHub/Substack/arxiv's. Same project as link-research-extraction (the shared task source), offset 2h from it on the same 4h cadence so the two jobs don't race the tasks.json lock. Disabled pending a human enable once the yt-dlp fetch path (t-2950) has shipped and been validated live — see that task before flipping this on. Before enabling: YouTube's bot-check blocks unauthenticated yt-dlp (t-3033, spec §7), so export a cookie jar to the persisted default path ~/.config/brana/yt-cookies.txt at mode 0600 (recipe in docs/guide/features/knowledge-drain-links.md § YouTube needs an authenticated session) — brana picks it up with no flag (t-3038, spec §8) and refuses a jar readable by others. Without the jar, every run fails exactly as the unauthenticated drain did live on 2026-08-23. An explicit `--cookies <path>` still overrides the default.
